# Commit author/committer emails using these domains fail the
# "Commit Author Hygiene" CI check (.github/workflows/commit-author-hygiene.yml).
#
# Purpose: keep employer / corporate email addresses out of commit metadata.
# A corporate domain in the git author field attributes the work to that
# employer (IP concern) and — when the address isn't linked to the author's
# GitHub account — trips the "require extra approval for unattributed changes"
# branch rule, stalling the PR at the merge gate. See issue #96.
#
# One domain per line. Comments (#) and blank lines are ignored. Matching is
# case-insensitive against the part after the last '@'. A leading '@' is optional.
mercy.com
